purpose: A bare yield suspends one by-reference foreach over a temporary object array. Observe pending THROW, unchanged scalar getters and explicit close; distinguish the acquired array-reference wrapper from the visited item CV alias, without forecasting stdout.

<?php
class ReferenceLoopA25 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReferenceLoopB25 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function referenceLoopChild25() { echo "C|"; try { foreach ([new ReferenceLoopA25(), new ReferenceLoopB25()] as &$item) { echo "V|"; yield 7 => 5; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "BAD-CHILD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function referenceLoopMiddle25() { echo "M|"; try { yield from ($GLOBALS["child"] = referenceLoopChild25()); } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function referenceLoopOuter25() { echo "O|"; try { yield from ($GLOBALS["middle"] = referenceLoopMiddle25()); } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$exception = new Exception("reference-loop25"); echo "P|"; $outer = referenceLoopOuter25(); $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|T|";
try { $middle->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $exception ? "SAME|" : "OTHER|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? "NOPREV|" : "PREV|"; }
echo "GET|", $middle->current(), "|", $middle->key(), "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
unset($caught, $exception); echo "E";
